# checkmk_service_label_rules (Resource)

Sets labels for services matching specified conditions. This is a typed wrapper around the `service_label_rules` ruleset. Requires activation.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `properties` (Attributes) Rule properties including description, comment, and disabled status. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--properties))
- `value` (Map of String) Map of label names to values to assign to matching services.

### Optional

- `conditions` (Attributes) Conditions that determine when this rule applies. All specified conditions must match (AND logic). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--conditions))
- `folder` (String) The folder path where the rule will be created. Default is '/' (root folder).

### Read-Only

- `api_id` (String) CheckMK's internal UUID for the rule. Used for updates and deletes.
- `id` (String) Computed hash based on description and conditions. Used for Terraform identity.

<a id="nestedatt--properties"></a>
### Nested Schema for `properties`

Required:

- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the rule. Required and part of rule identity.

Optional:

- `comment` (String) Optional comment for the rule.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is disabled. Default is false.


<a id="nestedatt--conditions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `conditions`

Optional:

- `host_label_groups` (List of String) Match hosts by label group names (CheckMK 2.3+). **WARNING:** Cannot be used with `host_label_rules` or `service_label_rules` rulesets (circular dependency).
- `host_labels` (Attributes List) Match hosts by label conditions (CheckMK 2.2+). **WARNING:** Cannot be used with `host_label_rules` or `service_label_rules` rulesets (circular dependency). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--conditions--host_labels))
- `host_name` (Attributes) Match hosts by name pattern. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--conditions--host_name))
- `host_tags` (Attributes List) Match hosts by tag conditions. Multiple tag conditions are combined with AND logic. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--conditions--host_tags))
- `service_description` (Attributes) Match services by description pattern. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--conditions--service_description))
- `service_label_groups` (List of String) Match services by label group names (CheckMK 2.3+). **WARNING:** Cannot be used with `service_label_rules` ruleset (circular dependency).
- `service_labels` (Attributes List) Match services by label conditions (CheckMK 2.2+). **WARNING:** Cannot be used with `service_label_rules` ruleset (circular dependency). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--conditions--service_labels))

<a id="nestedatt--conditions--host_labels"></a>
### Nested Schema for `conditions.host_labels`

Required:

- `key` (String) Label key (e.g., `environment`, `team`).
- `operator` (String) Label match operator. Options: `is` (exact match), `is_not` (negation).
- `value` (String) Label value to match (e.g., `production`, `platform`).


<a id="nestedatt--conditions--host_name"></a>
### Nested Schema for `conditions.host_name`

Required:

- `match_on` (List of String) List of host name patterns (supports wildcards: `*`, `?`). Examples: `web-*`, `db-?.example.com`.
- `operator` (String) Match operator. Options: `one_of` (match any pattern), `none_of` (match none).


<a id="nestedatt--conditions--host_tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `conditions.host_tags`

Required:

- `key` (String) Tag group key (e.g., `criticality`, `location`).
- `operator` (String) Tag match operator. Options: `is` (exact match), `is_not` (negation).
- `value` (String) Tag value to match (e.g., `prod`, `us-east-1`).


<a id="nestedatt--conditions--service_description"></a>
### Nested Schema for `conditions.service_description`

Required:

- `match_on` (List of String) List of service description patterns (supports wildcards). Examples: `CPU.*`, `Disk /var.*`.
- `operator` (String) Match operator. Options: `one_of` (match any pattern), `none_of` (match none).


<a id="nestedatt--conditions--service_labels"></a>
### Nested Schema for `conditions.service_labels`

Required:

- `key` (String) Label key.
- `operator` (String) Label match operator. Options: `is`, `is_not`.
- `value` (String) Label value to match.
